title: 第3章 泼天富贵第4章 开始进化
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 男子一身的登山装，应该是违规进入西山，为了看日出而来。
他找了个合适的地方，开始搭起了帐篷。
天海市，天海大学。
林小幽将一颗金色的果实，小心翼翼的放入包里。
“世界要变了吗？”
她抬头望着已经恢复黑暗的夜空，心中无比震撼。
自从下午和哥哥通过电话后，她就没有去上课，晚上宿舍熄灯了她也没有回宿舍，而是跑到了宿舍楼后的足球场。
她静静的等待着凌晨的到来，没想到真的有流星雨来袭。
规模空前庞大，百年难遇。
数千年的记载中，从未有过如此大规模的流星雨。
“居然真的和哥哥说的一模一样。”
林小幽看到，流星雨过後，有很多的光团落在了学校里面。
“我得多捡一些。”
她想起了哥哥的叮嘱，於是鼓起勇气，壮着胆子，在足球场找到了六个光团，将里面的东西收入包里。
凌晨的学校，本来很是寂静。
不过流星雨来袭，还是让一些学生起床观看了起来。
随着流星雨临近，光团落下，整个学校沸腾了，整个昆市沸腾了，甚至全世界在这一晚都沸腾了起来。
半小时的时间，全世界不知道有多少人接触了光团，得到了里面的东西。
回宿舍的路上。
“又有一个！”
林小幽一脸欣喜，小心翼翼的将光团里面的东西摸入怀中。
她揣着七个果实，快步回到了宿舍。宿舍楼里，很是嘈杂，不再是平时的寂静。
西山顶。
林羽看着自己半小时的收获，心情澎湃。
“足足62个奇珍。”
除了小瓷瓶之外，还有7张卡牌，三枚红色果实，16枚黄色果实，35枚绿色果实。
“这简直就是泼天富贵啊！”
现在真正的进化还没有到来，他也没有鉴定术，但他知道这些东西的价值。
末世初期拥有这些，足以让一个人成为强≈x4b7e;。
在末世，每一个走上进化之路的人，最初始的四维属性都不高。
正常人的四维属性是
【力量：5点】
content_en:
The man was wearing mountain climbing clothes. He must have entered Xishan Mountain illegally to watch the sunrise.
He found a suitable place and began to set up the tent.
Tianhai City, Tianhai University.
Lin Xiaoyou carefully put a golden fruit into the bag.
“Is the world going to change?”
She looked up at the dark night sky, feeling extremely shocked.
Since talking to her brother on the phone in the afternoon, she has not gone to class. She did not go back to the dormitory when the lights were turned off at night. Instead, she ran to the football field behind the dormitory building.
She quietly waited for the early morning to arrive, but she didn't expect that a meteor shower would actually come.
The scale is unprecedented and rare to see in a century.
In thousands of years of records, there has never been a meteor shower of this magnitude.
"It's actually exactly what my brother said."
Lin Xiaoyou saw that after the meteor shower, many light groups fell in the school.
"I have to pick up some more."
She remembered her brother's advice, so she mustered up the courage to find six light groups on the football field and put the contents in her bag.
The school was originally very quiet in the early morning.
However, the meteor shower came and some students still got up to watch.
As the meteor shower approached and the light clusters fell, the whole school was boiling, the whole Kunming City was boiling, and even the whole world was boiling that night.
In half an hour, countless people around the world came into contact with the light group and obtained the contents inside.
On the way back to the dormitory.
"There's another one!"
Lin Xiaoyou looked delighted and carefully touched the contents of the light ball into her arms.
She carried seven fruits and quickly returned to the dormitory. The dormitory building was very noisy, and it was no longer the usual silence.
West top.
Lin Yu looked at what he had gained in half an hour, and felt very excited.
"A total of 62 rare treasures."
In addition to the small porcelain bottle, there are 7 cards, three red fruits, 16 yellow fruits, and 35 green fruits.
"This is simply overwhelming wealth!"
The real evolution has not yet come, and he does not have identification skills, but he knows the value of these things.
Having these in the early days of the end of the world is enough to make a person a strong person.
In the last days, everyone who embarks on the path of evolution will have low initial four-dimensional attributes.
The four-dimensional attributes of normal people are
[Magic power: 500]
[Strength: 5 points]
